scope: Development checks of the provider and bounded drawing repair. Fresh whole-source static verification has its own receipt. These checks do not qualify trained models or general desktop competence.

separateLocalAssessment.input: Only the actual cropped Paint canvas

nativeDrawing.review: The observed canvas matches the inspected geometric preview. It is a crude dog line drawing. Human observation is not calibrated model assessment or objective subject ground truth.
nativeDrawing.ownership: One newly created Paint document. No input to earlier windows. Private stores and window receipts remain outside the repository.
nativeDrawing.effects: Select Pencil and black color, then bounded canvas drags. No save, overwrite, import or upload.

finalCodexContainment.limit: One trusted installed CLI and owned temporary canary. This does not sandbox a malicious executable.

liveCli.codex: PASS for installed gpt-5.5 and default models, including the full desktop decision schema after strict wire-schema conversion. No desktop input.
liveCli.claude: UNRUN because Claude CLI is not installed. Safe proposal mode requires an API key and bare execution. Subscription OAuth mode is unsupported.

consoleDevelopmentChecks.scope: Real Chromium, Vue, Fastify and SQLite with disposable stores and explicit provider fixtures. No native input or remote provider call.

liveEnsemble.promptScope: Public synthetic structured proposal. No screenshots or desktop input.
liveEnsemble.meaning: Application-level proposal selection. This does not change model weights or implement a neural mixture of experts.

reportedOllama400.diagnosis: The screenshot alone does not establish the cause. Current text, image and actual Paint planning calls succeeded. HTTP failures now return bounded recovery messages without copying raw model output.

historicalEvidence: Earlier learning, OS profile and release evidence retain their original source bindings. Requalify experimental models on current source and machine.
